verdict.rationale: Shopify documents first-party MCP servers for agents: Global Catalog, Storefront Catalog, Cart, Checkout and Order MCP. Runtime probes confirm live JSON-RPC handshakes at catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp and at a storefront's /api/ucp/mcp endpoint, and a real cart was created through the protocol. missing for 10: ungated access to the full tool set (Order MCP and complete_checkout are Token-tier only, and agents must host a UCP profile), independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect any AI assistant to real-time commerce data from Shopify stores with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
The Global Catalog MCP server enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem, helping buyers find products from multiple merchants.
The Cart MCP server enables AI agents to build and iterate on a cart before the buyer commits to purchase.
a keyless JSON-RPC initialize POST to https://catalog.shopify.com/api/ucp/mcp completed a FULL handshake
